model_metadata.model_name: MobileNetV4 Fruit Ripeness & Shelf-Life Classifier (Philippine Fruits)

pipeline_stages.name: Neural Foreground Matting (U2-Net)
pipeline_stages.description: Erases background tables, paper plates, napkins, and background clutter to generate a continuous alpha matte [0.0, 1.0].

pipeline_stages.name: Tight Bounding-Box Crop & Black Canvas Letterbox
pipeline_stages.description: Extracts the fruit bounding box from the alpha mask and centers it onto a square solid black canvas (0, 0, 0) of size max(w, h) before resizing to 224x224. This preserves the natural aspect ratio of the fruit without stretching.

pipeline_stages.name: Grad-CAM Heatmap Visualization
pipeline_stages.description: Highlights ripeness hotspots and blemishes with glowing red/yellow over deep navy blue.

pipeline_stages.name: Postharvest Shelf-Life & Storage Advisory
pipeline_stages.evidence_source: Postharvest Horticulture Training and Research Center (PHTRC) & PhilMech Literature Rules

unripe-banana.guidance: Keep at room temperature (20–25°C) with good airflow, away from direct sunlight and ethylene sources. Do not refrigerate.

ripe-banana.guidance: Keep in a cool, dry, ventilated place and consume soon. Refrigeration darkens the peel but keeps pulp firm for 2 additional days.

overripe-banana.guidance: Consume immediately for eating or peel and freeze for smoothies and baking if pulp is sound. Discard if fermented or moldy.

unripe-mango.guidance: Keep whole at room temperature in a dry, ventilated, shaded area. Do not refrigerate until partially ripe.

ripe-mango.guidance: Keep in the coolest shaded area available and consume soon. Brief refrigeration extends eating quality.

overripe-mango.guidance: Consume immediately if still sound; otherwise discard.

unripe-papaya.guidance: Keep at room temperature in a dry, shaded area until ripe. Avoid rough handling and inspect daily.

ripe-papaya.guidance: Consume promptly. Brief refrigeration after ripening extends edible quality.

overripe-papaya.guidance: Consume immediately only if still sound; otherwise discard.
